---
title: "uv-python pandas ecosystem rendering"
engine: uv-python
format: html
uv-python:
  with:
    - pandas
execute:
  echo: false
---

This fixture uses transient `uv-python.with` dependencies. The captioned pandas
table is referenced as @tbl-ecosystem-pandas.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ecosystem-pandas
#| tbl-cap: Pandas dataframe rendered by uv-python
import math
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "name": ["Ada", "Grace", "Katherine"],
        "note": ["literal | pipe", "line one\nline two", "backtick ` cell"],
        "score": [98, None, math.nan],
    },
    index=pd.Index(["row-a", "row-b", "row-c"], name="person_id"),
)

df
```

Explicit `display(df)` should use the same dependency-free table formatter.

```{python}
from uv_python_runtime import display

display(df)
```

Pandas Series values render as a two-column table with the index and the series
name.

```{python}
pd.Series(["alpha", "series | pipe", None], name="series_value")
```
